title: ReEvo: Large Language Models as Hyper-Heuristics with Reflective Evolution
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems

publication.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems

mechanism.domainTask: Reflective LLM hyper-heuristics for combinatorial optimization
mechanism.populationDetail: Maintains a population of heuristic-code individuals under a genetic-programming loop; no island or explicit tree organization is described.
mechanism.archiveDetail: The current best heuristic is explicitly treated as the elite and serves as the base of elitist mutation, though separate archive storage/admission is not fully specified.
mechanism.replacementDetail: The paper specifies a heuristic population and elite-guided mutation, but not the complete post-crossover/post-mutation population survivor update.
mechanism.generationDetail: Initialization generates heuristics from task context; crossover synthesizes from two parent heuristics; elitist mutation modifies one current-best heuristic using accumulated reflection.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: Relative parent performance and aggregated objective values condition crossover reflection and elite mutation; long-term verbal memory persists across iterations.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: Crossover samples two successfully executed heuristics at random while avoiding equal objective values; mutation uses the current best elite as one parent. Overall parent count varies by stage.
mechanism.outOfTaxonomy: Short-term comparative verbal gradients and accumulated long-term reflection memory are coupled to crossover and elite mutation as persistent natural-language guidance.

provenance.citationWarning: Do not infer a replacement policy from the term elitist mutation; population survivor updates are not fully specified. The best heuristic is used as a mutation parent, but separate archive storage is unclear. Parent arity varies between two-parent crossover and one-parent elite mutation. E/E behaviors exist as crossover and elite refinement, but no explicit controller is described.
